info.name: Ticky CRM
info.summary: Open-source CRM and client management for Nextcloud
info.description:
A modern, open-source CRM built from the ground up for Nextcloud. Ticky CRM provides seamless client management, automated interaction logs, and activity tracking.
Milestones: - Customer Management (done) - Customer Notes (done) - Contacts Integration (done) - Products (next) - File Integration (next) - Deck Integration (next) - Helpdesk (future) - Quotes (future)
Please note: This project is currently in its early stages of development. We are actively looking for feedback, ideas, and feature suggestions—contributions from the community are highly welcome!
